name: nginx-multisite
description: Nginx reverse proxy and multi-site web server with SSL termination, security hardening, UFW firewall management, fail2ban intrusion prevention, and sysctl kernel hardening. Serves three internal subdomains with self-signed TLS certificates, HTTP→HTTPS redirect, HSTS, and security response headers.

name: cache
description: Dual caching layer that installs and configures both Memcached and Redis on the same host, with Redis password authentication and a post-install config patch to strip incompatible directives generated by the redisio cookbook.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Full-stack Python FastAPI application deployment that clones a Git repository, sets up a Python virtual environment, provisions a PostgreSQL database, writes a .env configuration file, and registers a systemd service unit running uvicorn on port 8000.

name: nginx
description: Fully migrated Ansible role for a generic Nginx web server, including tasks, handlers, Jinja2 templates, defaults, vars, meta with argument specs, and a complete Molecule test suite.
